children: Werner Enterprises entered a new unsecured $1.1 billion revolving credit facility maturing Oct 5, 2031, led by BMO Bank as Administrative Agent. The company drew $465 million at a 5.54% weighted average rate based on SOFR plus a margin and will use proceeds for refinancing, working capital, capex, acquisitions, and general corporate purposes. Concurrently, Werner terminated its $1.075 billion 2022 facility early, repaying $428 million outstanding (plus interest and fees) using $431.7 million from the new line, extending maturities and simplifying its capital structure.
: BMO Bank, as Administrative Agent, and a syndicate of lenders
: Refinance debt and enhance liquidity for corporate purposes
: Replaced by the 2026 credit facility with extended maturity

title: Werner Enterprises Secures $1.1 Billion Five-Year Unsecured Credit Facility to Refinance Debt
